_comment: Ground-truth format for the loss-run extraction eval. The real truth sets
(set1.json, set2.json, set3.json — 80 binders, 400 graded cells) are
gitignored: their keys are client binder filenames and their values name
the insureds. This file shows the schema with fictional binders.
Key   = the binder's filename, exactly as it sits in binders/.
Value = the five graded fields. Each is a LIST of acceptable answers,
because some binders genuinely carry more than one defensible one
— a package policy naming four policy numbers, a blended
D&O/EPL/Fiduciary form, an excess layer where either the fronting
carrier or the syndicate is a fair answer.
policy  : compared ignoring case and punctuation
eff     : normalised to MM/DD/YYYY before comparison
null means 'the binder does not state one', which the engine is expected
Add a binder here whenever a format breaks, so the fix stays fixed.
